result.quote: And after the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
result.reason: The action is supported, but the wording wrongly suggests that the old prophet had been eating; the man of God was the one who finished eating and drinking. Also, “for him” does not establish that it was the man’s own donkey. A supported wording would ask what the old prophet did after the man of God finished eating and drinking, with the answer: “He saddled the donkey for him.”
